status.resent: The document changed after you approved it: please approve again.
status.notYetLater: You will be notified when it is your turn.

status.completedBody: The documents are signed. Nothing else is needed from you.

status.returnedBody: You will be notified when the author sends them again.

paused.rebuilt: The document changed after it was sent. The author will check it and send it again.
paused.sent_changed: The version of the document out for signing changed outside the route. The author will send the documents again.
paused.marks_changed: Signatures in the document changed outside the route. The author will send the documents again.
paused.frozen_changed: The final PDF changed outside the route. The author will send the documents again.
paused.participant_left: The signers changed. The author will assign another signer.
paused.returned: The documents were returned for revision. The author will send them again.
paused.unknown: The author will send the documents again.

status.draftBody: You will be notified when the author sends the documents.

via.pades: with an e-signature in the PDF

method.title: How to sign
method.approveOnly: No signature in the document, approval only.

image.ready: Your signature image is ready. It appears in the document once you approve.

esign.plateMissing: The signature plate needs a key or certificate.
esign.noServerKeys: This server does not store private keys, so you cannot create or import a key here. Sign with CryptoPro or upload a ready signature.
esign.noServerKeysPlate: This server does not store private keys, so you cannot create or import a key here. For the plate, use a CryptoPro certificate or a public key file.
esign.padesNoKeys: An e-signature in the PDF needs a Studio key, and this server does not store private keys. Pick another method or return the documents to the author.

wayHint.studio: The server signs. It does not store the key password.
wayHint.cryptopro: The key stays on the token. You pick the certificate next.
wayHint.file: An .asc, .sig or .p7s file made on your side.

esign.fileAfterFreeze: The final PDF appears after you approve. You sign it in the next step.
esign.fileHint: Download the PDF, sign it on your side and upload the signature file.

nudge.files: Upload a signature file for every document.

failure.doc_changed: The document changed while this page was open. Review the new version and try again.
failure.not_your_turn: It is not your turn right now. The page has been refreshed.
failure.plate_required: Set a key or certificate for the signature plate first.
failure.network: The server is unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
failure.method_not_allowed: This signing method cannot be chosen right now: the checkpoint does not accept it or there is no place for the signature on the page. Pick another one.
failure.visible_layer_final: The documents are already frozen: the image, the method and the plate cannot be changed.
failure.stale_route: The route changed while you were acting. The page has been refreshed, try again.
failure.server_keys_forbidden: This server does not store private keys. Sign with CryptoPro or upload a ready signature.
failure.route_locked: The document is on a signing route: signatures change only in turn.
failure.not_found: The route is closed or you are no longer part of it. Refresh the page.
failure.signature_invalid: The signature does not match the final PDF. Sign the downloaded file unchanged.
failure.no_secret_key: The file has no private key. A public key only works for the plate.
